introduction.purpose: This document specifies the requirements for the Sleet Student Management system, a web-based application designed to manage student enrollments, course workflows, and administrative tasks in educational institutions. It serves as a formal agreement between stakeholders and the development team.
introduction.document_conventions: Requirements are numbered sequentially within features. Priority levels are High, Medium, Low. All requirements are testable and atomic.

product_scope.summary: The system will provide a centralized platform for managing student data, course enrollments, approvals, reporting, and notifications for educational institutions, accessible via web browsers.
goals: Deliver the primary Sleet student management. user workflow through a web application.
Support scalable growth with modular MERN microservices.
business_objectives: Reduce manual effort in the primary business process.

product_perspective.system_context: Sleet Student Management is a standalone web application that integrates with notification services and supports role-based access for students, teachers, admins, and managers. It operates on a microservices architecture using Node.js, Express, React, and MongoDB.

user_classes_and_characteristics.characteristics: Enrolls in courses, views grades, receives notifications, limited access to personal data only.
Manages course content, submits grades, approves enrollments, views analytics for their courses.
Full system access, manages users, courses, and settings, generates comprehensive reports.
Oversees multiple courses or departments, approves workflows, views aggregated reports.

overall_description.operating_environment: The system will run on modern web browsers (Chrome, Firefox, Safari, Edge) and server environments supporting Node.js 18+, MongoDB 6+, and Express 4.x.
design_and_implementation_constraints: Must use MongoDB for data persistence
Must implement microservices architecture with Express
Frontend must be built with React
All APIs must follow REST conventions
Response time must be under 2 seconds for all operations
overall_description.assumptions_and_dependencies: Assumes stable internet connectivity for users, availability of MongoDB and Node.js environments, and integration with email services for notifications. Dependencies include MongoDB Atlas, Node.js runtime, and React libraries.

user_interfaces.description: Responsive React-based UI supporting desktop and mobile views, with role-specific dashboards and forms.

hardware_interfaces: None specified; standard server and client hardware assumed.

software_interfaces.description: Database for storing all application data including users, courses, enrollments, and reports.
SMTP-based service for sending notifications and alerts to users.

communications_interfaces: WebSocket for real-time notifications (optional future enhancement)

performance_requirements: All system responses shall be delivered within 2 seconds under normal load conditions.
The system shall support concurrent access by at least 500 users.
safety_requirements: The system shall not expose sensitive data to unauthorized users.
All user actions shall be logged for audit purposes.
security_requirements: All data transmissions shall be encrypted using TLS 1.2 or higher.
User passwords shall be hashed using bcrypt before storage.
software_quality_attributes: Maintainability: Code shall follow modular microservices architecture.
Usability: UI shall be intuitive and require minimal training for end-users.
business_rules: Only admins can create new courses.
Teachers can only approve enrollments for their assigned courses.
Students can only view their own enrollment records.

database_requirements: MongoDB shall be used with collections for users, courses, enrollments, and reports.
Database indexes shall be optimized for frequent queries on enrollment status and user roles.
internationalization_requirements: The system shall support English language initially, with placeholders for future localization.
legal_requirements: The system shall comply with FERPA for student data privacy in educational contexts.
All data retention policies shall adhere to institutional guidelines.
reuse_objectives: Microservices shall be designed for potential reuse in other educational applications.
API endpoints shall follow standard conventions for interoperability.
additional_requirements: The system shall include backup and recovery procedures for database integrity.
API rate limiting shall be implemented to prevent abuse.

endpoints.description: Authenticate user with email and password.
Register a new user with role assignment.
Search and retrieve enrollments with filters.
Approve or reject an enrollment request.
Send email notifications for system events.

glossary.definition: A record representing a student's registration in a course, including status and dates.
